sentences.text: PEATZ is a cohort company whose country is recorded as DK, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The record shows grant or public funding of EUR 118 000 dated 2024-11-30, and a first customer or pilot named on the same date at low confidence.
It also holds a programme-entry record for 2024 and an award record for 2022, both with the year only.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09.
Technology, business and investment readiness are unknown on the radar's rules because the funding is not from a source those rules read.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and the funding record is the first thing to check at its source.
